messages:
hana: Quick announce -- we're publishing the new "Release & Docs Cadence" memo in 20m. It standardizes minor SDK release windows, docs sync cadence, and a short naming convention for runtime compatibility flags. please review for any red flags.
tom: thanks. what's the high-level cadence? monthly minors, quarterly majors?kevin: High level: monthly minor releases (bugfixes + non-breaking additions), quarterly feature releases for bigger changes, and a twice-yearly major compatibility review. Docs will follow a weekly docs-sync with a single source-of-truth branch.
hana: Correct. Also new rule: any param rename or behavioral change that could be user-facing requires a deprecation note in docs at least 45 days before release, plus a compatibility flag pattern: `compat_<feature>_v<semver>` (example: `compat_retry_v1`).
docs-bot: Docs build queued: staging preview -> build 5310 (will post link on publish) :hourglass_flowing_sand:mira: Ops question: will Hosted enable compat flags by default for a window? we need to avoid breaking pipelines in the wild.carlos: Hosted will turn compat flags on for 30 days after the announcement for any flagged change; after that we'll flip to default-off for new tenants. Dedicated/Private: admin console permits manual toggles and timeline extensions.
kevin: Are there any changes to how we record telemetry for deprecations? I want to be able to roll up lists of callers that still use old APIs.hana: Yes -- new telemetry keys: `release.candidate`, `docs.deprecation.warn`, and `compat.flag.engaged`. Docs includes console queries and a sample dashboard. Also added a lightweight export CSV for top callers.
legal-bot: Quick legal check passed. For customers under contracting addenda, include a contractual extension path and a one-click escalation template in the Account playbook. Also added language for privacy-first telemetry in EU regions.
tom: Docs: can we add a tiny migration checklist and a codemod pointer? many teams want a one-click script.kevin: Added. Included a safe codemod repo link and examples for Python/JS. We also included a `dry-run` flag for codemods and a test harness snippet: run both old and new calls and assert identical top-3 tokens.
mira: Will partner integrators get a separate, branded communication? carlos: Yes, Partnerships will get a tailored email + a CSV of affected partners generated from telemetry. We added an internal template in the memo.
hana: Plan: publish memo, pin in #sdk-announcements, and send the partner email. If no blockers, publishing in 20m. :rocket:
